Week 1 (Feb 3-7)   Week 2 (Feb 10-14)      Week 3 (Feb 17-21)      Week 4 (Feb 24-28)
├─ Cleanup         ├─ Component refactor   ├─ Vite optimize      ├─ PWA config
├─ Audit           ├─ Service kernels      ├─ Rust tuning        ├─ Capacitor
├─ Archive         ├─ deps cleanup         ├─ Binary strip       ├─ Mobile UI
└─ Baseline        └─ NPM shrink           └─ CSS/assets         └─ Release


🔧 DAILY EXECUTION COMMANDS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WEEK 1 (Cleanup & Audit)
  Day 1: pnpm ls --depth=10 > audit/deps.txt && git status
  Day 2: mkdir .archive_docs && mv AUDIT_*.md .archive_docs/
  Day 3: pnpm audit && cd src-tauri && cargo audit
  Day 4: find src -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.ts" | xargs wc -l
  Day 5: pnpm run build && du -sh node_modules dist/

WEEK 2 (Consolidation)
  Day 6-7: Refactor components → MessageCell, ChatBubble (4 files)
  Day 8: pnpm remove electron @storybook/* && pnpm install --force
  Day 9-10: Consolidate services → ChatKernel, AIKernel, TauriIPCBridge

WEEK 3 (Build Optimization)
  Day 11: Update vite.config.ts (manual edits provided)
  Day 12-13: Update Cargo.toml, strip binary, cargo clean
  Day 14-15: PurgeCSS cleanup, image optimization, WebP conversion

WEEK 4 (Mobile & Release)
  Day 16: npm install @capacitor/cli && npx cap init titane
  Day 17: npx cap add android && npx cap sync
  Day 18: pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build
  Day 19: Create RELEASE_NOTES_v38.0.0.md
  Day 20: git tag v38.0.0 && git push origin v38.0.0
